description: Skelet P10-D1: consented replay-event ledger with redaction, budgets, and deterministic replay (no donor vendoring)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: new migration 017 plus replay module plus tests plus one CI test-list line; flows/artifacts/galleries/patterns untouched; migration rehearsal still symmetric; no MCP/REST/UI change yet? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the ledger factually correct: explicit-consent sessions on readable flows; strict type/timestamp/data envelope validation; input-text masking plus mutation value removal plus credential-custom redaction before storage; per-session seq ordering; close lifecycle; event/byte budgets; deterministic repeat reads?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 7 replay tests green (consent, mask-and-replay, redaction units, malformed, close lifecycle, 2000-event budget exhaustion, outsider nulls); migration rehearsal green; lint/typecheck clean; graft build/check green; no genuine rrweb binary claim?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: examined readability re-checked on record and replay; closed sessions refuse writes but keep stable reads; budget failures leave prior events intact; down migration drops only the new tables?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the P10-D1 ledger grain: MCP/REST transport, replay UI, live rrweb capture, or unrelated refactors? Is transport honestly deferred to the D2 follow-on?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: raw passwords and tokens never stored (masked pre-insert with secret-absence assertion); outsider opens/records/reads/closes read as null without oracle; malformed envelopes fail closed; actor binding on every call; no network?

state.change: P10-D1 replay ledger: migration 017 replay_sessions/replay_events plus packages/db/src/replay.ts (consent, validation, redaction, budgets, ordering) plus 7 tests plus CI wiring. No transport yet.
